title: Output-path defects destroyed three completed efilter runs after measurement

defects.failure: circular JSON reference at manifest / summary emit
UnicodeEncodeError printing U+2192 under cp1252 stdout after all tasks completed
defects.countermeasure: configure_utf8_stdio at process start; PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 in launchers; dry-run non-ASCII log+print probe; seal before fancy report prints (C2d)

defects.stage: post-measurement seal (median context ratio 7.12 already measured)
defects.countermeasure: schema allows outputs.tasks (emitter was correct); dry-run rebuilt on build_efilter_summary + efilter_output_paths so shape parity is structural (C2e)

finding: Three completed runs were lost to write-path defects discovered only after the measurement finished. The startup dry-run existed but validated a hand-constructed synthetic that omitted fields the real emitter adds (notably outputs.tasks), so it was structurally incapable of catching schema drift. C2e requires the dry-run to call the same summary builder and the same outputs catalog as the real emit path, with a nested key-set parity test.
dry_run_coverage_required: manifest emit via real outputs catalog (steps + tasks)
summary built by build_efilter_summary (not a hand fixture)
nested key-set parity vs a second builder call

outputs_tasks_decision.why: E-FILTER legitimately writes tasks.jsonl (per-task machine measurement + context ratios) and indexes it under outputs, parallel to steps.ndjson. additionalProperties:false on outputs requires every real artifact path to be enumerated; omitting the pointer would hide a sealed artifact from the manifest catalog. Older stage-1 sealed runs predate the file and correctly omit the optional key.
